summary: Python 2.2 unified Python's types (C extensions) and classes (Python types) into one hierarchy, making the object model purely and consistently object-oriented. Generators were added, inspired by Icon. Nested scopes from 2.1 were enabled by default. This release was a major step toward modern Python.
notes: Unsupported since 2003-05-30. Last micro 2.2.3. Generators would later enable iterator-based programming and async patterns.
